translations.web: He has also prepared for himself the instruments of death. He makes ready his flaming arrows.
translations.bsb: He has prepared His deadly weapons; He ordains His arrows with fire.
translations.kjv: He hath also prepared for him the instruments of death; he ordaineth his arrows against the persecutors.
translations.asv: He hath also prepared for him the instruments of death; He maketh his arrows fiery shafts.
